mapping(uint96 => uint256) poolLTs;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Venus Core Pool Comptroller\n     * @dev All emergency functions operate directly on this comptroller.\n     *      On BSC this is /// @notice Stored pre-incident market state snapshots, keyed by vToken market address.\n    /// @dev Values are captured at tightening time (first-write-wins) and cleared via resetCFSnapshot() / resetCapSnapshot().\n    mapping(address => MarketState) public marketStates;\n\n    /// @dev Storage gap for future upgrades.\n    uint256[49] private __gap;\n\n    /// Diamond comptroller (venus-protocol).\n    constructor(ICorePoolComptroller corePoolComptroller_, bool isIsolatedPool_) {\n        if (address(corePoolComptroller_) == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n\n        COMPTROLLER = corePoolComptroller_;\n        IS_ISOLATED_POOL = isIsolatedPool_;\n        _disableInitializers();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Initialize the EBrake proxy with the Access Control Manager.\n    /// @param accessControlManager_ Address of the Venus Access Control Manager.\n    function initialize(address accessControlManager_) external initializer {\n        if (accessControlManager_ == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        __AccessControlled_init(accessControlManager_);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IEBrake\n    function pauseActions(address[] calldata markets, IComptroller.Action[] calldata actions) external {\n        _checkAccessAllowed(\"pauseActions(address[],uint8[])\");\n        if (markets.length == 0 || actions.length == 0) revert EmptyArray();\n\n        uint256 actionsLen = actions.length;\n        for (uint256 i; i < actionsLen; ++i) {\n            _validateAction(actions[i]);\n        }\n        IComptroller(address(COMPTROLLER)).setActionsPaused(markets, actions, true);\n        emit ActionsPaused(msg.sender, markets, actions);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IEBrake\n    function pauseSupply(address market) external {\n        _checkAccessAllowed(\"pauseSupply(address)\");\n        _pauseSingleAction(market, IComptroller.Action.MINT);\n        emit ActionPaused(msg.sender, _pauseSingleAction(market, IComptroller.Action.REDEEM);\n        emit ActionPaused(msg.sender, market, IComptroller.Action.REDEEM);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IEBrake\n    function      (bool isCorePoolListed, , , , , , ) = COMPTROLLER.poolMarkets(corePoolId, market);\n            if (!isCorePoolListed) revert MarketNotListed(corePoolId, market);\n            for (uint96 i = if (newCF >= currentCF) continue;\n                _snapshotCF(state, i, currentCF, currentLT);\n                uint256 err = COMPTROLLER.setCollateralFactor(i, market, newCF, currentLT);\n                if (err != 0) revert SetCollateralFactorFailed(err);\n                emit CollateralFactorDecreased(msg.sender, market, i, newCF);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc currentCF, currentLT);\n        uint256 err = COMPTROLLER.setCollateralFactor(poolId, market, newCF, currentLT);\n        if (err != 0) revert SetCollateralFactorFailed(err);\n        emit CollateralFactorDecreased(msg.sender, market, poolId, newCF);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IEBrake\n    function setMarketBorrowCaps(address[] calldata markets, uint256[] calldata newBorrowCaps) anyDecreased;\n\n        for (uint256 i; i < marketsLen; ++i) {\n            uint256 currentCap = comptroller.borrowCaps(markets[i]);\n            if (newBorrowCaps[i] > currentCap) {\n                revert CapExceedsCurrent(markets[i], currentCap, newBorrowCaps[i]);\n            }\n            // Only act when this element actually tightens. {\n                    state.supplyCap = currentCap;\n                    state.supplyCapSnapshotted = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (anyDecreased) {\n            comptroller.setMarketSupplyCaps(markets, newSupplyCaps);\n            emit SupplyCapsDecreased(msg.sender, markets, newSupplyCaps);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // _checkAccessAllowed(\"resetSupplyCapSnapshot(address)\");\n\n        MarketState storage state = marketStates[market];\n        state.supplyCap = 0;\n        state.supplyCapSnapshotted = false;\n\n revokeFlashLoanAccess(address).details: Only meaningful on Diamond comptroller (BSC) where the flash loan whitelist exists.      On non-BSC chains the underlying call will revert (selector mismatch on IL comptroller).      This is the surgical alternative to `pauseFlashLoan()`, which kills flash loans for      every whitelisted account. Use it when a single whitelisted integrator is compromised.      The boolean argument is hardcoded to `false` inside the implementation to preserve      the EBrake "tighten only, never loosen" invariant. Re-granting access is governance-only.      Idempotent: if the account is not currently whitelisted, the call is a no-op and      no event is emitted. FlashLoanAccessRevoked is a true state-change signal.
